name: Wuxian zhi Wu
source:
I thought it was just an ordinary day, but I accidentally entered this endless cycle of rooms. Among the countless terrifying and anomalous things, there is a girl who seems like she shouldn't exist here.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2839430]Steam[/url]]
translation:
本以为只是平凡的一天，却无意间进入了这无尽循环的房间。在无数恐怖异常的事物中，有一个女孩，她似乎不应该存在于这里。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2839430]Steam[/url]]
